candidates.change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) guard with require(true), allowing empty input arrays and changing the function's behavior for empty arrays.
Replace the keccak256 selector string with an empty string, causing the external calls to use a different function selector.
Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i < 0, skipping all iterations and returning true without any external calls.
Change the increment to i += 2, causing every other token transfer to be skipped.
Swap the recipient and amount arguments in the external call, sending the amount as the address and the recipient as the amount.
Change the failure check from if (!_s) to if (_s), reverting on success and succeeding on failure.
Change the final return value from true to false.
Remove the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing execution with empty arrays which changes the revert/success behavior.
Change the inner call to not revert on failure by replacing the if-revert block with an empty block, so failed sub-calls are silently ignored and transfer returns true instead of reverting.
Replace 'return true' with 'return false', making the function return a different boolean value on success.
Remove the entire for-loop body, so no external calls are made, but the function still returns true — changing whether external effects happen.
